title: [Bug] `Unsupported value: 'messages[0].role' does not support 'developer' with this model` for o1-preview in Tier 2
body:
### 📦 Environment

Other

### 📌 Version

1.50.0 (self-hosted)

### 💻 Operating System

Windows

### 🌐 Browser

Other

### 🐛 Bug Description

When I try to send a new message to a conversation hosted by  "o1-preview" or "o1-mini", I got an error like below.

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "unsupported_value",
    "type": "invalid_request_error",
    "param": "messages[0].role",
    "message": "Unsupported value: 'messages[0].role' does not support 'developer' with this model."
  },
  "endpoint": "https://api.openai.com/v1",
  "provider": "openai"
}
```

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c83f310a-49b3-4a99-a465-4ee924202b87)

I assume that this is likely to be caused by the changes in https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat/pull/5657 .
I got no errors when I was trying the same in `v1.49.16`.

- Environment: self-hosted (I build my own image with https://github.com/MaySoMusician/lobe-msm-build)
- Browser: Brave `Version 1.74.51 Chromium: 132.0.6834.160 (Official Build) (64-bit)`



### 📷 Recurrence Steps

1. Select "o1-preview" or "o1-mini" as a model.
2. Start a conversation.


### 🚦 Expected Behavior

Got no errors.

### 📝 Additional Information

If you need to pull my image, run `docker pull ghcr.io/maysomusician/lobe-msm-build:1429495`, but I believe that this can be caused in the official image.
